stemMd: What is the complete real solution set of $(x-1)(x-6)<0$?
explanationMd: The two factors have opposite signs only between the roots. The strict inequality excludes both endpoints, producing the open interval from 1 to 6.

distractorRationale.b: The endpoints give zero, not a negative product.
distractorRationale.c: The product is positive outside the roots.
distractorRationale.a: Both factors are negative there, giving a positive product.
